summary.en: Synthesize interview evidence into themes, counterexamples, and decision-relevant insights.

exclusions: Statistical analysis of a representative survey

required_inputs.description: Authorized interview notes or transcripts with anonymized participant IDs
Research objective and any recruitment or sample context

workflow.instruction: Extract observations and quotations with source locations while minimizing unnecessary identifying details.
Code recurring needs, behaviors, workarounds, and pain points without treating frequency as statistical prevalence.
Group themes and actively preserve disagreements, exceptions, and uncertainty.
Turn supported patterns into implications and follow-up questions, separating participant evidence from analyst interpretation.

deliverables.name: Interview synthesis
deliverables.acceptance_criteria: Contains evidence-backed themes, counterexamples, implications, and limitations

deliverables.name: Evidence map
deliverables.acceptance_criteria: Links each theme to anonymized participants and source locations

limitations: Small or biased samples cannot establish population prevalence.
Do not infer sensitive traits or diagnoses from interview language.
permission_boundaries: Do not contact participants, upload recordings, or disclose identities without authorization.
Do not use sensitive attributes to make high-impact decisions about people.

summary.ko: 결정에 필요한 변수와 중립적인 질문·응답 선택지·분석 계획을 설계합니다.
summary.en: Design a concise survey with neutral questions and a clear plan for interpreting responses.

exclusions: Sending surveys or collecting live responses

required_inputs.description: Decision to support, target population, and research questions
Survey length, distribution context, required measures, and privacy constraints

workflow.instruction: Map each research question to a construct and explain how the response will inform a decision.
Write neutral, single-purpose questions with appropriate answer scales and non-overlapping options.
Order questions to reduce priming and burden; include skip logic and optional responses only where needed.
Create an analysis plan and pilot checklist, identifying sampling and nonresponse limitations.

deliverables.name: Survey draft
deliverables.acceptance_criteria: Each item includes question, type, options, required status, logic, and purpose

deliverables.name: Analysis and pilot plan
deliverables.acceptance_criteria: Explains interpretation, quality checks, and sampling limitations

limitations: A well-written survey does not guarantee a representative sample.
Do not reuse proprietary standardized instruments without checking permission.
permission_boundaries: Do not publish the form, recruit participants, collect sensitive data, or offer incentives.
Avoid unnecessary identity fields and disclose intended data use in the draft.

summary.ko: 원본을 보존하며 형식·결측·중복·값 범위를 점검하고 변환 이력을 남깁니다.
summary.en: Clean tabular data reproducibly while preserving originals and documenting every transformation.

required_inputs.description: Authorized tabular data and field definitions if available
Intended use, known valid ranges, identifiers, and normalization requirements

workflow.instruction: Profile types, missing values, duplicates, formats, ranges, and unexpected category values before changing records.
Define explicit transformation rules and distinguish mechanical normalization from business decisions.
Apply safe transformations to a separate output, preserving identifiers and flagging ambiguous records rather than deleting them silently.
Reconcile input and output row counts, calculate validation checks, and produce a transformation log with unresolved exceptions.

deliverables.name: Cleaned dataset
deliverables.acceptance_criteria: Preserves source meaning and identifies unresolved records

deliverables.name: Data quality report
deliverables.acceptance_criteria: Includes checks, counts, transformation rules, and unresolved exceptions

limitations: Outliers are not automatically errors.
Do not infer missing values or deduplicate entities without a defensible rule.
permission_boundaries: Do not overwrite originals, delete records, query production systems, or upload data externally without authorization.
Minimize sensitive fields and do not use data to infer protected personal attributes.

summary.ko: 확인된 분석을 의사결정 질문에 연결하고 근거·한계·다음 행동을 설명합니다.
summary.en: Turn verified analyses into an evidence-led report with practical, qualified recommendations.

required_inputs.description: Verified research or analysis outputs with sources and methods
Audience, decision to support, constraints, and requested report length

workflow.instruction: Identify the central decision and select findings that materially affect it rather than listing every observation.
Check that numbers, comparisons, quotations, and causal statements are supported by the source analysis.
Organize the report into answer, evidence, alternatives, limitations, and recommended next actions.
Tie each recommendation to evidence, assumptions, expected benefit, and a way to verify whether it worked.

deliverables.name: Insight report
deliverables.acceptance_criteria: Contains a decision-focused summary, evidence, caveats, alternatives, and actionable recommendations

deliverables.name: Evidence-to-action map
deliverables.acceptance_criteria: Links each recommendation to findings, assumptions, and validation

limitations: Do not transform weak evidence into confident causal conclusions.
Recommendations involving regulated or high-stakes decisions need appropriate expert review.
permission_boundaries: Do not distribute the report, make commitments, or change operational systems.
Do not reveal identifiable research participants or confidential client data unnecessarily.
